id: title:adamleithp:show starting state on session dot

review.posthog_relevance: Adds session recovery and task-starting marker support to the session store, distinguishing cloud and non-cloud environments, and clearing markers to prevent duplicates.
review.reason: Adds optional setTaskStarting and clearTaskStarting methods to the ISessionStore interface and implements checks for existing connected sessions and non-cloud environments. This establishes the contract and implementation for tracking task creation and recovery, distinguishing cloud and local task creation, and preventing duplicate markers. This is a substantive, bounded capability
review.uncertainty: Chunk does not include complete implementation of backend, shared domain types, session recovery and eviction paths, or useTaskSessionStarting hook, making it impossible to assess full implementation and systemic impact.

observations.limitations: This chunk does not include the implementation of the backend or shared domain types, nor the complete implementation of the session recovery and eviction paths. The chunk also does not include the implementation of the useTaskSessionStarting hook or the complete implementation of the session store setters. This makes it impossible to assess the full implementation and its impact.}

observations.behavior: Adds optional setTaskStarting and clearTaskStarting methods to ISessionStore interface.
observations.posthog_connection: Defines the contract for the session store to support tracking task creation in-flight.

observations.behavior: Adds checks for existing connected session and sets task starting marker before connecting.
observations.posthog_connection: Clears the starting marker if a session is already connected, preventing duplicate markers.

observations.behavior: Adds check for non-cloud environment before setting task starting marker.
observations.posthog_connection: Only sets the starting marker for non-cloud environments, distinguishing between cloud and local task creation.
